The flaw is in the self-clearing design, and the cases do not probe it. Write troubles reach the one slot from many stores through reportStorageTrouble: assets (useAssets:152, the big blobs most likely to hit quota), themes, projects, bookmark/signOff, sign-out eviction. noteStorageOk('write') on ANY withStore success would clear a quota trouble raised by an asset blob write as soon as a tiny step record saves.
